name: neo-urbe
description: Neo Urbe — a cyberpunk isometric city builder that runs in the browser.

scripts.desktop:build: BASE_PATH=./ pnpm --filter @neon/web exec vite build --outDir ../desktop/www --emptyOutDir && pnpm --filter @neon/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/kernel && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/simulation && tsc -p packages/bridge && tsc -p packages/view-iso && tsc -p packages/chrome && tsc -p packages/theme && tsc -p packages/theme-urbe && tsc -p packages/theme-neon && tsc -p packages/view-city && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/neon && tsc -p apps/desktop && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:simulation && pnpm build
